title: SM ST8C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST8C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} sets the proportional gain of the voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} sets the integral gain of the voltage regulator, {Maximum voltage regulator output, V_PImax (pu)} sets the maximum output of PI regulator, {Minimum voltage regulator output, V_PImin (pu)} sets the minimum output of PI regulator, {Field current regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} sets the proportional gain of the field current, {Field current regulator integral gain, K_IA (pu/s)} sets the integral gain of field current regulator, {Maximum exciter output, V_Amax (pu)} sets the upper limit of exciter output, {Minimum exciter output, V_Amin (pu)} sets the lower limit of exciter output, {Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent gain, K_A (pu)} sets the rectifier bridge gain, {Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} sets the rectifier bridge time constant, {Maximum field current regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the maximum output of field current regulator, {Minimum field current regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} sets the minimum output of field current regulator, {Exciter field current feedback gain, K_F (pu)}, {Field current feedback time constant, T_F (s)} sets the feedback time constant, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)}, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit gain coefficient, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)}, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B1max (pu)} sets the maximum available exciter field voltage, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)}, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} sets the compound circuit current gain coefficient, {Maximum available exciter field voltage, V_B2max (pu)} and {Power source selector}. Values come from the instance.
